newsitem.title: USA: United Stationers sees higher Q1 net.
newsitem.headline: United Stationers sees higher Q1 net.

text.p: United Stationers Inc said Thursday it expects to report 1997 first quarter earnings in a range of $0.62-$0.65 a share, up from the $0.51 reported in the comparable period a year ago.

United Stationers also expects 1997 first quarter sales to show an increase of 8.2 percent to $635 million from the $587 million reported in the 1996 first quarter, executive vice president Daniel Bushell told analysts in remarks prepared for a New York meeting.
"Our first quarter is the strongest sales period due to the seasonal nature of our busienss," he said.
United Stationers is North America's largest wholesaler of business products to resellers.
